Lemma
[uniform radial upper bound]

↗ lem:dc-ch3-4-2-segment-length

1. ch3:4.2For the joining geodesic segment of item 5, the distance from the base $q=\varphi _p^{-1}(y)$ to its endpoint is at most the chart-Gram norm of the initial velocity, \[ d\big(q,\gamma (1)\big)\le \sqrt{\langle w,w\rangle _{p,y}}, \] uniformly in the base point $y$.
Proof

\sketch

The distance between the endpoints of a $C^1$ curve is at most its length; combine this with the length identity section 3. This is the $\le $ half of the normal-ball minimizing property (item 2), now available uniformly in the base point $y$ — the direction that does not require a base-uniform Gauss estimate.

□
